title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode21 Nightcord at 25:00

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, there she is! Hey, over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're fine. Yuki still isn't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She messaged me saying her class ran late, but she should be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know we just saw each other yesterday, but this is still our first time meeting up in the real world. It feels a little weird.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure meeting in the other world like that counts. I finally feel like I can be sure you two actually exist. It's so strange.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You look at all the pictures I post, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well yeah, but you just seem different now that I'm actually meeting the real you in person.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see. For starters, now I know for sure that you're always using filters when you post your pictures♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No problem! We haven't been here long! We still haven't even ordered.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright then. Let's start with a round of introductions! My name is Mizuki Akiyama. Call me Mizuki♪ Okay, Enanan, your turn.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm Ena Shinonome. It feels a little weird introducing myself again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we never really did use your real name after you told us. I'll make sure to start using it now♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you use the characters for midwinter? It makes sense why you chose Yuki since it means snow.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's nice to finally meet you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for causing so much trouble.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, do you actually feel bad for what you did?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure. I don't really know myself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously? You're the one who caused this whole mess. The least you could do is feel sorry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're not going to be like this from now on, are you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know! Let's order!
My tummy's a-rumbling! What are you getting, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a late lunch, so I'm just getting some cheesecake and an iced tea.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, hey! You gotta decide for yourself, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll go with the wonton noodles and an oolong tea.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Good, we're all decided. Let's order and make a toast!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For the first official offline meeting of N25, of course! That's the whole reason I asked everyone here today♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you two okay with this level of energy?

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Sorry for the wait. Here's your order.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, thank you♪ Let's see. Kanade and Mafuyu ordered oolong tea and Ena had the iced tea. Great, everyone has their drinks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let the first official offline meeting of N25 begin! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Cheers... You really are way too excited.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think that's probably good for today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I listened to the song you wrote.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's not responding. I wonder if she fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My songs still aren't enough for Mafuyu. But someday...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm glad you found each other.
